summary_markdown: The participants discussed a proposed system or tool (linked via URL) designed to collect information and generate summary tables. Initial discussion focused on the best channel for this process, with one participant suggesting it should happen in a general chat rather than private messages. It was clarified that the system appears to ask questions privately before posting a summary table publicly.
decisions: The proposed data collection method involves asking questions via private message and then publishing a summary table to a public/general channel.
